run_visualize_policy: run a MuJoCo policy visualization script with a specified environment name and pickle policy file
run_policy_evaluation: run policy evaluation in a Gym environment for a set number of episodes with rendering enabled
create_MLP_policy: create an MLP Gaussian policy with configurable hidden layer sizes and log standard deviation
load_pickle_policy: load a pickled policy file from disk and use it for environment interaction
review_main: review the main CLI function that renders policy episodes and prints episode scores
